text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hopeful Stakes is finally here!
—Epiphaneia-san is the overwhelming favorite, isn't she!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Heavy favorite!
Yeah, I like the sound of that!

Yes, Epiphaneia drew even more attention
than during his debut...
Expectations were so high you could easily call him the overwhelming favorite.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ever since their debut races, it looks like fans
of Cesario-san and Symboli Kris S-san
have been really cheering them on!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'm so happy!
I want everyone to pay even more attention to me!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"If it's a GⅠ race, destiny should be much easier to feel!
The voices are saying so, too!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Destiny...? A voice...? ...Um,
this is your first GⅠ race,
are you feeling any pressure?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: None at all!!!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Impressive as always! Now then, to wrap things up,
please share your enthusiasm with us!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...When is this article going to be published?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I'll come out before the race, though...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! In that case,
spread the word about what I'm about to say with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I want everyone to come see me!
If you do, I promise—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'll make you feel the hand of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "The overwhelming favorite Epiphaneia makes a confident claim! She looks poised to deliver the results everyone expects"...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I mean, look!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Look at this! Every single outlet is talking about me!"

...With so much attention on us,
I'm the one starting to feel the pressure.
My stomach is in knots...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's wrong?
Does your tummy hurt?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Call an ambulance!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: What, are you nervous?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is your first GⅠ as a Trainer too.
No wonder you're nervous!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing pathetic about it at all!
It just shows how seriously you've been taking this!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“Still, rest easy!
Everything is definitely going to go great today too!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Because I believe in myself!
—And in you, who guided me all the way here!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Fear nothing! Just wait with a smile for the victory I'll bring you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: The voice of destiny says so too!!
choice_data_list: ...All right, give it your all out there!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“—Well, isn't it gonna be Epiphaneia?”
“I heard she's got quite a unique personality...
but her skill definitely seems legit.”

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Epi-san,
she's super popular.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
I'll be taking notes on your current strength, okay~?
For next year's sake—
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sweet!
Everyone's looking at me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's start from here!
—With a race that bestows destiny!
